# Beacon by Monolith

> Emergency lighting testing software for UK contractors. Test on site (even offline), keep a living site register, and issue BS 5266 paperwork from the visit — free in open beta.

Monolith Compliance builds Beacon: Field (phone/tablet, offline-capable) for on-site monthly and annual emergency lighting tests, and Console (desktop) for sites, team, history, and certificates.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/): Product overview, demo walkthrough, sample paperwork, FAQ
- [Privacy](https://www.monolithcompliance.co.uk/privacy.html): Privacy notice
- [Beacon app](https://beacon.monolithcompliance.co.uk/): Sign in / open beta product

## Product facts

- Audience: UK contractors, competent persons, multi-site managers doing BS 5266 emergency lighting work
- Field: on-site testing, defects, history; works with no signal; add to home screen (no App Store)
- Console: sites, team, audit history, organisation branding on PDFs
- Paperwork: fitting test report, visit periodic inspection report, site periodic inspection and testing certificate
- Import: bring fittings from an existing spreadsheet/logbook
- Pricing: free in open beta; pricing announced before any charges
- Not a BSI product certification; duty-holder remains responsible for fire-safety compliance
- Contact: feedback@monolithcompliance.co.uk
